shell.help.zh:
可用命令:

  文件操作:
    add <source> [dest]      - 添加文件/目录到容器
                                source: 本地文件路径
                                dest: 容器内路径（可选）

    rm <path>               - 删除容器内的文件
                                path: 容器内路径

    mv <from> <to>          - 移动/重命名文件
                                from: 源路径（容器内）
                                to: 目标路径（容器内）

    ex <input> <output>      - 导出文件到本地
    （别名: export）
                                input: 容器内路径
                                output: 本地路径

  查看信息:
    free                       - 树状显示容器内容
    （别名: ls）

    info                       - 显示容器详细信息
                                （大小、文件数、类型分布）

  其他:
    help                       - 显示此帮助信息

    exit                       - 退出 shell 模式
    quit                       - 退出 shell 模式（别名）

  示例:
    veil> add photo.jpg photos/vacation.jpg
    veil> free
    veil> mv old.txt archive/old.txt
    veil> ex archive/old.txt ./backup.txt
    veil> rm archive/old.txt
    veil> exit
shell.help.en:
Available commands:

  File operations:
    add <source> [dest]      - Add files/directories to container
                                source: Local file path
                                dest: Virtual path in container (optional)

    rm <path>               - Delete files from container
                                path: Virtual path in container

    mv <from> <to>          - Move/rename files
                                from: Source path (in container)
                                to: Destination path (in container)

    ex <input> <output>      - Export files to local filesystem
    (alias: export)
                                input: Virtual path in container
                                output: Local path

  View information:
    free                       - Display container content as tree
    (alias: ls)

    info                       - Display container details
                                (size, file count, type distribution)

  Other:
    help                       - Show this help message

    exit                       - Exit shell mode
    quit                       - Exit shell mode (alias)

  Examples:
    veil> add photo.jpg photos/vacation.jpg
    veil> free
    veil> mv old.txt archive/old.txt
    veil> ex archive/old.txt ./backup.txt
    veil> rm archive/old.txt
    veil> exit
